manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Snail, causing you to scry 1.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
